source: This means the relative bottleneck depends on the shape regime. At modest context length and large model width, MLP/projection GEMMs can be a major share of work. At long dense contexts, attention’s pairwise sequence term grows rapidly. During one-token decoding, attention faces growing KV reads while the MLP continues processing only the current token.
zh: 这意味着相对瓶颈取决于形状体系。在适度的上下文长度和较大的模型宽度下，MLP/投影 GEMM 可能是工作的主要部分。在长密集上下文中，注意力的成对序列项快速增长。在单令牌解码过程中，注意力面临着不断增长的 KV 读取，而 MLP 继续仅处理当前令牌。
